arguments.prompt:
Design the WEEK LIST view of the same macOS-style personal productivity desktop app (same shell as the main screen: left sidebar #F7F7F8 with big 今天 title, date line, circular-checkbox todo rows; right main area #FFFFFF with the same toolbar).

MAIN AREA = Apple Reminders style week list for 2026年9月7日–9月13日:
- Toolbar identical to the main screen: left title "9月7日 – 9月13日" (19px semibold); right side two macOS segmented controls in light-gray containers (#F2F2F3, 7px radius): view switcher 周/月/年 with 周 active as white raised pill, and navigation ‹ 今天 ›.
- Seven slim day-group headers, one per day: "9月7日 周一" — day number+month in 13px semibold #1D1D1F, weekday in 12px #98989D, on a transparent background with a hairline bottom border rgba(0,0,0,0.06). Headers are compact (about 36px) and quiet, NOT colored blocks.
- Under each day header, that day's tasks as clean rows: 15px circular completion checkbox (1.5px gray border, blue fill with white check when done) + 14px task title #1D1D1F, hairline separators between rows, generous 10px row padding, faint hover background. Completed tasks show dimmed strikethrough text.
- Content: 9月7日 has 团队周会 (repeating, small ↻ mark after title); 9月9日 has 回复评审意见 and 整理周报; 9月11日 has 版本发布; 9月8日, 9月10日, 9月12日, 9月13日 are empty (just the slim header — whitespace is part of the design).

STYLE: same quiet macOS-native language — system font stack, single accent #007AFF, hairline dividers, no cards, no shadows on rows, no gradients.
